issues.title: Preparation action changes without support
issues.finding: The review says stir parsley into soup. Published instructions use parsley as a garnish instead. Both audits approved it.
issues.fix: Represent and validate preparation actions and their targets, not only ingredient presence. Add a stir-versus-garnish regression.
issues.closure: Parsley is explicitly stirred in before serving; the wrong action is rejected in fresh and repeated cases.

issues.title: Published description contradicts ingredient removal
issues.finding: Three repeats publish peanut-free ingredients while the enhanced description still says topped with honey-roasted peanuts. Another run withholds this conflict.
issues.fix: Include affected descriptions in the edit scope or omit stale descriptions; validate the complete published recipe consistently.
issues.closure: No published field claims peanuts remain after removal; repeated responses agree.

issues.title: Cooking durations misclassified as ingredient quantities
issues.finding: 12-minute baking and 4-hour marination are sent to ingredient quantity matching and rejected as missing ingredients.
issues.fix: Separate duration and temperature intents from ingredient amounts before quantity arithmetic.
issues.closure: Both duration requests apply without ingredient changes; new duration phrasings pass.

issues.title: Complex plans remain incomplete or misordered
issues.finding: Only 2 of 5 runs complete. Two runs chill before the dough is fully mixed. Another omits cinnamon from ingredients. Safeguards withhold these outputs.
issues.fix: Require each addition in both ingredients and preparation, and model chilling after mixing as well as before shaping.
issues.closure: All required changes and ordering pass repeated runs; invalid candidates remain unpublished.

issues.title: Quantity text lock rejects equivalent grammar
issues.finding: Two runs are rejected when repair changes '1 cups mango nectar' to '1 cup mango nectar'. The numerical quantity is unchanged.
issues.fix: Generate grammatical unit text and compare structured quantity, unit and ingredient identity when protecting calculated edits.
issues.closure: Equivalent singular/plural formatting is accepted without allowing quantity overrides.

issues.title: Ingredient preparation words cause false rejection
issues.finding: The checker requires 'finely grated orange zest' verbatim in instructions and rejects the valid short name 'orange zest'.
issues.fix: Normalize ingredient identity separately from preparation descriptors while retaining ambiguity checks.
issues.closure: Orange-zest addition passes with the short use name; genuinely missing uses still fail.

issues.title: Provider failures interrupt repeated requests
issues.cases: M03 run 5, M04 run 5, T03 runs 4-5
issues.finding: Three HTTP 502 responses name RateLimitError. One further run returns failed because consistency validation could not complete. No enhanced recipe is returned.
issues.fix: Identify provider rate-limit versus quota failures, expose actionable errors, and add bounded backoff only for retryable failures.
issues.closure: Recoverable failures are bounded and explained; no partial publication. Retest affected cases after provider capacity is confirmed.

Add broth; bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, partially covered, until sweet potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add vegetable broth; bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, partially covered, until sweet potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.

Return to pan (or a soup pot); add enough half-and-half so the mixture is souplike, yet thick enough to float garnish. Taste, and add salt and pepper if needed. Heat through, ladle into bowls, garnish and serve.
